lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Dwayne Konate is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Dwayne is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Dwayne Konate is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Dwayne kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Dwayne's gone." Rachid looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Dwayne." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Sophia blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Dwayne Konate, 41 days. The mantle passes to Sophia Liu.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sophia Liu, 23 — a Pharmacist. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Dowsing.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Dwayne — and Dwayne is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Rachid, James, Hassan and 4 more speak for Sophia — "Dwayne trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Sophia before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d70: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d70: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d70: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d70: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
